content:
sophia: Heads-up — eu-west embeddings + rerank started spiking around 06:00 UTC. GPUs hit ~95% and we saw a flurry of 429s from the rerank endpoint.
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled service=rerank-pool-eu-west +2 nodes (policy: reactive) :gear:
omar: Is this concentrated to one tenant or a global spike?
sophia: Looks concentrated. One big customer sent a high-fanout batch of rerank jobs (high-k). Embedding lane mostly fine but network egress and queueing spilled into shared qmgr so rerank backlog grew.
raj: We should enforce lane-level admission control + per-tenant soft limits. If rerank lane gets saturated, route low-priority requests to a batched fallback pool.
kate: Agreed. Suggest adding a preemptive throttle config. Example:
```json
{
  "lane": "rerank",
  "concurrency_limit": 40,
  "token_rate": 5000,
  "per_tenant_soft_limit": 10,
  "burst_multiplier": 1.2
}
```
maria: Replicating a separate rerank pool per region adds cost. Can we degrade to cheaper quantized model or CPU-serve for low-priority rerank while preserving SLO for critical traffic?
omar: For fairness, allow a 10% burst credit, then requeue into batch-only path. Also consider a fast-path that accepts only low-k requests when under pressure.
sophia: Immediate mitigation: applying a per-tenant softlimit for tenant-id-394 and enabling rerank_fallback=model-rerank-small. Will also enable requeue TTL so requests don't loop forever.
deploy-bot: rollout: set rpcs.policy.preemptive_throttle=v1 -> canary to eu-west (3 hosts)
infra-bot: preemptive throttle active for tenant-id-394 on rerank lane. Current queue depth for rerank-eu-west: 12 -> stable after throttle.
raj: Follow-up metrics we need: per-lane queue_depth, per-tenant requeue_rate, L5 latency, GPU_util_active, preempted_request_count, fallback_rate.
kate: Also add requeue_ttl=30s and max_requeues=2 to admission controller to prevent hot-looping.
maria: +billing_tag in the routed requests so we can map extra compute to the tenant invoice.
sophia: I'll keep an eye on dashboards. If rerank_queue_depth > 100 for 2m we should page oncall. Opening a short incident doc if it flares back up :eyes:
omar: Good. Can someone add a Grafana panel for breakdown by tenant and lane? That will help triage instead of guessing.
kate: I'll add panels and a dashboard template. Also pushing a small change to make fallback model selection cost-aware.
infra-bot: Note: autoscaler may overshoot if backlog drains slowly — adding hysteresis in the next deploy.
sophia: Thanks team. For the postmortem, capture the fanout pattern, why qmgr allowed spillover, and whether network egress is the bottleneck vs. GPU slots.
maria: And capture cost tradeoffs for dedicated rerank lanes vs. dynamic fallbacks. We need a runbook decision for customers above X qps.
raj: I'll draft recommended QOS configs and share in #eng-runtime tomorrow.
sophia: Great. Closing thread for now — monitoring. :thumbsup:
